title: Incorrect EOF node handling
detail: The helper `_get_endmarker_and_dedents` returns a non-`ENDMARKER` leaf when the node is followed by a statement before the file ends. The caller then treats that leaf as an EOF node, incorrectly adding its prefix to the hidden comment and clearing it. This can corrupt code formatting when a `# fmt: off` block is followed by code before EOF.

title: Incorrect lock state check
detail: The code checks `self._export_lock.locked` as if it were an attribute, but Twisted's `DeferredLock` exposes a `locked()` method. This will raise an AttributeError at runtime, breaking the export flow.

title: Missing await on lock acquisition
detail: When the lock is free, the code calls `self._export_lock.acquire()` without awaiting the returned Deferred. This causes the coroutine to continue before the lock is actually acquired, potentially leading to race conditions and data corruption.
note: Says the lock is acquired without being awaited.

title: Incorrect accept_html logic
detail: The property should return True when ``text/html`` is accepted, but the code returns True when it is *not* present, causing the property to report the opposite of the intended value.
